    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f24" sourceRef="task_check_concurrence" targetRef="gw_supplier_concurrence" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f31" sourceRef="task_create_cis_contract" targetRef="task_check_contract_details" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f32" sourceRef="task_check_contract_details" targetRef="gw_withdraw_or_confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f33" name="withdraw" sourceRef="gw_withdraw_or_confirm" targetRef="task_withdraw_contract" />
